title: Interstellar
description: A team of astronauts travels through a wormhole near Saturn to find a habitable planet for humanity. A science fiction adventure about space, time, love, and survival.

title: Inception
description: A skilled thief enters people's dreams to steal secrets and is assigned an impossible mission to plant an idea inside someone's mind. A mind-bending science fiction thriller.

title: The Dark Knight
description: Batman faces the Joker, a criminal mastermind who creates chaos across Gotham City and challenges the limits of morality. A dark superhero crime thriller.

title: The Martian
description: An astronaut stranded alone on Mars uses science, engineering, and determination to survive while NASA plans a dangerous rescue mission. A realistic science fiction survival adventure.

title: Gravity
description: Two astronauts become stranded in space after a satellite collision destroys their spacecraft. A tense science fiction survival thriller about isolation and human resilience.

title: The Matrix
description: A computer programmer discovers that reality is a simulated world controlled by intelligent machines and joins a rebellion to free humanity. A philosophical science fiction action thriller.

title: Shutter Island
description: A US Marshal investigates the disappearance of a patient from a mysterious psychiatric facility on a remote island. A psychological mystery thriller filled with suspense and twists.

title: Avatar
description: A human soldier travels to an alien moon called Pandora and becomes involved in a conflict between humans and its indigenous inhabitants. A visually spectacular science fiction adventure.

title: Arrival
description: A linguist is recruited by the military to communicate with mysterious alien visitors whose arrival could change humanity's understanding of time and language. A thoughtful science fiction mystery.

title: Blade Runner 2049
description: A futuristic detective uncovers a secret that could reshape the relationship between humans and artificial beings. A visually atmospheric science fiction mystery.

title: Dune
description: A young nobleman travels to a dangerous desert planet containing the most valuable substance in the universe and becomes involved in a political and spiritual conflict. An epic science fiction adventure.

title: Tenet
description: A secret agent enters a world of inverted time and must prevent a global catastrophe using technology that reverses the direction of objects through time. A complex science fiction action thriller.

title: Edge of Tomorrow
description: A soldier trapped in a time loop relives the same battle against an alien invasion and gradually learns how to defeat the enemy. A science fiction action adventure.

title: Predestination
description: A time-traveling agent attempts to prevent crimes before they happen and becomes involved in a mysterious story of identity and destiny. A mind-bending science fiction thriller.

title: Ex Machina
description: A programmer is invited to evaluate an advanced humanoid artificial intelligence and begins questioning consciousness, manipulation, and the boundaries between humans and machines. A psychological science fiction thriller.

title: The Prestige
description: Two rival magicians become obsessed with creating the ultimate illusion, leading to deception, sacrifice, and unexpected consequences. A dark mystery thriller.

title: Gone Girl
description: A woman's disappearance turns her husband into the prime suspect and exposes a disturbing relationship filled with secrets and manipulation. A psychological mystery thriller.

title: Prisoners
description: A desperate father investigates the disappearance of his daughter and another child while a detective follows a disturbing trail of clues. A dark crime mystery thriller.

title: Se7en
description: Two detectives investigate a serial killer whose crimes are inspired by the seven deadly sins. A dark psychological crime thriller.

title: Fight Club
description: An unhappy office worker forms an underground fighting club with an unpredictable stranger, leading to a chaotic exploration of identity and modern society. A psychological drama thriller.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
description: A banker sentenced to life in prison develops an unlikely friendship and quietly maintains hope while navigating years of incarceration. An emotional prison drama about friendship and freedom.

title: Forrest Gump
description: A kind-hearted man with a simple outlook on life unexpectedly becomes part of several major historical events while searching for love and purpose. An emotional comedy drama.

title: The Green Mile
description: A prison guard encounters an extraordinary inmate with mysterious healing abilities, changing his understanding of humanity and justice. A supernatural emotional drama.

title: The Pursuit of Happyness
description: A struggling salesman faces homelessness while raising his young son and pursuing a life-changing career opportunity. An inspiring emotional drama about perseverance.

title: La La Land
description: An aspiring actress and a jazz musician fall in love while pursuing their dreams in Los Angeles. A romantic musical drama about ambition and relationships.

title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
description: A hotel concierge and his young assistant become involved in a mysterious inheritance dispute and a series of unusual adventures. A stylish comedy mystery adventure.

title: John Wick
description: A retired assassin returns to the criminal underworld after a personal tragedy and faces a dangerous network of professional killers. An intense action thriller.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
description: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a survivor joins a rebellious warrior in a high-speed escape from a ruthless tyrant. A visually intense action adventure.

title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
description: A teenager discovers his spider powers and meets alternate versions of Spider-Man from different dimensions. An animated superhero adventure about identity and responsibility.

title: Coco
description: A young boy who dreams of becoming a musician enters the Land of the Dead and uncovers the truth about his family's history. An emotional animated fantasy adventure.
